headword: {取扱注意|とりあつかいちゅうい}
reading: とりあつかいちゅうい

definitions.gloss: handle with care (label); something to be handled carefully
definitions.explanation: The label put on fragile parcels and on confidential or sensitive documents. Also used jokingly of a person or topic that needs careful handling.

examples.japanese: {取扱注意|とりあつかいちゅうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シール→シール：09597_shiiru⟧。
⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{取扱注意|とりあつかいちゅうい}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote "Handle with care" on the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{取扱注意|とりあつかいちゅうい}なので、⟦{社外|しゃがい}→社外：17992_shagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{出|だ}さないで→持ち出す：06160_mochidasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: These documents are confidential, so please don't take them out of the office.

notes:
Also written ⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧. On parcels it sits beside {割|わ}れ{物|もの}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (fragile) and ⟦{天地無用|てんちむよう}→天地無用：33172_tenchimuyou⟧ (this side up).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取扱注意|とりあつかいちゅうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧: a fragile parcel
- {取扱注意|とりあつかいちゅうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧: confidential documents
- {取扱注意|とりあつかいちゅうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: someone you have to handle carefully (humorous)
